title: purchase.submit input
description: Human-gated purchase submission for the purchase.submit operation. R3: spending money is a consequential effect; the exact-scope approval request is minted in the kernel approval gate and nothing is ever submitted without the operator's consumed approval — denials are recorded durably, and the vendor submission port activates only on the unforgeable authorized-operation proof relayed by the M10 governed dispatch (typed unavailable until a real backend exists, never simulated success). The optional approvalId is a model-supplied selector naming the exact approval on the gate-consumption dispatch route — never itself authority; the kernel consumes that exact approval server-side. The prepare route omits it. No account numbers, PANs, or credentials travel in arguments.

checkout.description: The governed-browser checkout this purchase runs on Colin's account (W6.5): the product page, its add-to-cart control, the vendor's checkout page and its place-order control, all on one https vendor site. Part of the approved request: the one approval covers exactly these pages and controls, and the order is placed only if the checkout page shows the approved amount.
